hints.sentence: Two different patients here often share a first name, last name, birth date and sex: names cluster by community and birth year, and many men who came to work the boats carry 1 January birth dates.
Many twins in the indexes were never registered together and were born outside the two hospitals, so neither the delivery log nor the visits show them.
Rule B's blood mismatches sit on Calder Bay records that already hold two patients, or on a record whose own typings disagree.
